region: Baiting Hollow · Long Island, New York
about: Long Island Spirits was founded in January 2007 by Richard Stabile in Baiting Hollow, on Sound Avenue at the western edge of the North Fork, and was the first craft distillery on Long Island since the 1800s. It is surrounded by thousands of acres of potato farms, and that crop became its signature: LiV vodka is distilled from local potatoes. The Pine Barrens line takes its name from the pine forest of central Suffolk County, and began with Pine Barrens American Single Malt, the first whisky distilled on Long Island.

This gin joins the two halves of the distillery. It starts with a potato spirit distilled to 191 proof in custom 650-liter copper pot stills and twin 19-plate copper rectification columns. A blend of 28 local and exotic fruits and botanicals steeps in the pot still for 36 hours, and the vapours then pass through a basket of more botanicals in a gin chamber. The finished gin is rested in oak barrels that previously held Pine Barrens single malt, which adds colour and notes of wood and vanilla, and is bottled at 94 proof.
